resources.string: SeekMind remembers the text of the screens you see, so that you can search it later.
What SeekMind remembers is encrypted on this phone and never sent anywhere.
Pause, exclude apps or delete everything, at any time.
SeekMind needs to read what is shown on your screen
To let you find again what you have seen, SeekMind uses Android\'s accessibility service (AccessibilityService API).
The text displayed in the apps you use, the app name, the screen title and the address of web pages.
When a screen mostly contains images or video, SeekMind occasionally analyses the image of the screen to recognise text in it. That image is processed in memory and is never saved.
Only to build your personal search index on this phone.
It stays on this phone, in an encrypted database. It is never sent, shared or sold — not to the publisher, not to the advertising network, not to anyone.
The app\'s Internet access is only used to display the ads you choose to watch. Those ads are never selected based on what SeekMind has read.
You can pause memorisation, exclude apps and delete everything at any time.
Password fields, private browsing, protected screens and sensitive apps (banking, password managers…).
SeekMind never performs actions on your behalf in other apps.
Scroll to the end of the text to agree.
What do you want to remember?
Banking, password managers and private browsing are never remembered.
Protect SeekMind with your fingerprint or your code
Keyword search works in every language. To also search by meaning in your language, add the multilingual pack (118 MB).
